description: Frozen eight-building replacement holdout for the v3 pre-CSS registration experiment. Selected before raster download or OCR from metadata-only LOC search results, then screened by exact HTTP HEAD sizes. The deterministic order is SHA-256 of '<building_type>:<loc_id>'; the solver takes the lexicographically first feasible two per type subject to seven-state diversity, 2-6 sheets per building, at most 32 sheets, hard byte budgets, and exactly two wholly unclassified catalog-caption controls. All 28 prior development and retired-holdout IDs are excluded. mt0670 was skipped because its 829,478,514 HTTP bytes exceed the 805,306,368 per-building limit.
